sample: Single crystal of SnF2 (composition known) with one polished face, face A. The spectra served by the lab are simulated from a physical forward model of this hidden sample, built from the database records below; treat them as measurements.
lab_frame: z is the outward normal of face A; the laser is incident along -z and the backscattered light is collected along +z, so the phonon wavevector is along z. Polarizer and analyzer angles are measured in the xy plane from +x.

face_B.note: face B is not polished and cannot be measured

instrument.raman_shift_axis: computed by the spectrometer software from the nominal laser wavelength
instrument.geometry: backscattering at normal incidence on face A, microscope objective, confocal
instrument.polarization: polarizer_deg sets the incident polarization, analyzer_deg the analysed scattered polarization; analyzer_deg null removes the analyzer (total scattered intensity). The crystal is treated as a thin plate: the fields inside it follow the polarizer and analyzer directions (birefringence and refraction neglected). The spectrometer throughput does not depend on polarization.
instrument.window: each request records one window of 320 cm-1 (centre +/- 160 cm-1) with 0.4 cm-1 pixels; centre in [-450, 650] cm-1
instrument.notch_filter: pixels within 18 cm-1 of the laser line are blocked and omitted
instrument.detector: CCD: offset 500 counts and read noise 5 counts rms per accumulation, photon (Poisson) statistics, flat spectral response; 60 s per accumulation
instrument.laser: constant power with 1.5 % rms power fluctuation between requests; laser heating is negligible

database.citation: M. Bagheri and H.-P. Komsa, High-throughput computation of Raman spectra from first principles, Sci. Data 10, 80 (2023); Computational Raman Database v1.0.1, Materials Cloud Archive record 0m9r0-g3486, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:pg-h3 (CC BY 4.0). Phonons from phonondb (PBEsol, VASP).
database.conventions: Records are the archived values (floats rounded to 6 significant digits). Frequencies in cm-1 at the Gamma point without LO-TO splitting. eigenvectors[mode][atom][xyz] are normalized eigenvectors of the mass-weighted dynamical matrix. raman_tensors[mode] (null if inactive) is R = (V_c/4 pi) d chi/d xi, xi the normal coordinate along eigenvector/sqrt(mass); the Stokes cross-section of Bagheri & Komsa is proportional to omega_s^4 (n+1)/omega |e_s.R.e_i|^2. born_charges is archived in phonopy BORN form (each 3x3 row: first index electric field, second atomic displacement); epsilon_inf is the electronic dielectric tensor. Cartesian frame and cell as in cell_A (rows are lattice vectors, Angstrom).
